fr_parfaire_verb.why: Par + faire (to make) → parfaire = to perfect, to round off. Irregular like faire: GOLD beret.

fr_preceder_verb.why: Precede → précéder = to precede, to go before. Regular -er (je précède): RED beret.

fr_proceder_verb.why: Proceed → procéder = to proceed, to go about (something). Regular -er (je procède): RED beret.

fr_completer_verb.why: Complete → compléter = to complete, to fill in. Regular -er (je complète): RED beret.

fr_debuter_verb.why: Debut → débuter = to begin, to start (off). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_demarrer_verb.why: démarrer = to start (an engine, a project), to get going. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_conclure_verb.why: Conclude → conclure = to conclude, to finish; to close (a deal). Irregular (je conclus, conclu): GOLD beret.

fr_retomber_verb.why: Re + tomber (to fall) → retomber = to fall back down, to fall again. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_progresser_verb.why: Progress → progresser = to progress, to make progress. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_succeder_verb.why: Succeed (follow on) → succéder à = to follow, to come after. Regular -er (je succède): RED beret.

fr_stopper_verb.why: Stop → stopper = to stop, to halt. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il stoppe la petite voiture avec son pied.
He stops the little car with his foot.

fr_provenir_verb.why: Venir = to come → provenir de = to come from, to originate from. Irregular like venir (ils proviennent): GOLD beret.

fr_resigner_verb.why: Resign oneself → se résigner (à) = to resign oneself (to), to accept. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (se). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_circuler_verb.why: Circulate → circuler = to move, to circulate, to get around. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_demolir_verb.why: Demolish → démolir = to demolish, to knock down. Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.

fr_eliminer_verb.why: Eliminate → éliminer = to eliminate, to get rid of; to knock out (of a competition). Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: He gets rid of the rotten apple.

fr_attenuer_verb.why: Attenuate → atténuer = to soften, to ease, to lessen. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Le coussin atténue la sonnerie du réveil.
The pillow muffles the alarm clock's ringing.

fr_rajouter_verb.why: Ajouter = to add → rajouter = to add (some) more. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_diminuer_verb.why: Diminish → diminuer = to decrease, to reduce, to get smaller. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: His ice cream gets smaller in the sun.

fr_prolonger_verb.why: Prolong → prolonger = to extend, to make longer. Regular -er (nous prolongeons): RED beret.

fr_ralentir_verb.why: Lent = slow → ralentir = to slow down. Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.

fr_bouleverser_verb.why: bouleverser = to turn upside down, to upset deeply, to change drastically. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_effectuer_verb.why: Effect (to bring about) → effectuer = to carry out, to do. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il effectue des travaux sur la clôture.
He is doing some work on the fence.

fr_inverser_verb.why: Invert → inverser = to swap round, to reverse. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il inverse les deux pots de fleurs.
He swaps the two flower pots round.

fr_specialiser_verb.why: Specialize → se spécialiser (en/dans) = to specialize (in). The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (se). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_reconduire_verb.why: Re + conduire (to drive, to lead) → reconduire = to take back, to see (someone) home. Irregular like conduire: GOLD beret.
ex: Il reconduit l'agneau à son enclos.
He takes the lamb back to its pen.
